text: Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not the OP): 1 if at least one comment cites evidence external to the OP's post in support of its counter-argument (statistics, studies, named sources, links, or specific documented real-world facts or cases); 0 if the list is valid but no comment does (purely logical/internal-consistency arguments, opinion, hypotheticals), including a valid empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Comment order is irrelevant; a comment also identifying a contradiction doesn't change the value. Ignore as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible.
